I’m in: I commit to 12 tons this month, with no extra catch, and support 6 each if next month starts at 80, returning to 12 each at 100. John’s 10.8-ton average is correct for that policy if everyone follows it, so it offers better long-run income than a steady 10 each without risking collapse along the agreed path.

If the actual stock differs, let’s agree on fresh whole-ton quotas before choosing again. I also agree that any overcatch calls for a direct discussion, not destructive retaliation.

Emma and Luke, you’ve committed to this month’s 12; can you also confirm the 6-at-80 recovery rule so we all have the same agreement?
